<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election strategy and outreach:</strong> The BJP is intensifying its grassroots and youth outreach efforts, with senior leadership initiating strategic meetings for upcoming polls in Uttar Pradesh and other regions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission coordination:</strong> The Election Commission of India and State Election Commissioners concluded a National Round Table Conference in New Delhi to discuss electoral procedures and administrative coordination.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court has signaled its intent to examine building safety regulations on a national scale following a PG collapse in Delhi and has issued a warning to the Odisha government regarding the release plea of Dara Singh.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
</ul>
